mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past three months signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the past two months signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS shows a sustained decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) shows an annualized increase of less than 2%, it signals a potential monetary policy pivot, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL annualized increase is less than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the past month, coupled with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points, signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS decrease > 100k and UNRATE increase > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000 and UNRATE increases by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over the past two months signals strengthening demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST shows a sustained increase.

mechanism_narrative: When the GDP (GDPC1) shows a quarterly growth rate below 1% and Industrial Production (INDPRO) declines over the past month, it signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth < 1% and INDPRO decline in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 quarterly growth is below 1% and INDPRO declines.
